name: design.md
summary: Tool that extracts a website's design system into a DESIGN.md file AI coding agents read before generating UI.
description: Paste a public URL in the web app or run the CLI to extract the real colors, typography, spacing, shadows, radii and dark mode of a site into a DESIGN.md, tokens.json, a preview page and a pixel-fidelity proof. Built for Claude Code, Cursor, v0, Lovable and similar agents; four example extractions ship with the repo (Stripe, Linear, Vercel, Supabase).
contains: paste a URL to get DESIGN.md plus tokens.json, preview.html and proof.html
4 gold-standard examples: Stripe, Linear, Vercel, Supabase
colors clustered in OKLCH with stability classification; typography, spacing, shadows and radii
ships a SKILL.md agent skill and a universal AI prompt per extraction
free, no signup or API key; MIT licensed
